verdict.rationale: Honeycomb's account-creation docs let a user choose the account's region, with explicit European Union and North America options. This directly delivers a user-selectable region at signup. missing for 10: an explicit statement that telemetry is stored and processed in the chosen region (residency guarantees), any regions beyond EU and NA or a way to migrate between them, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Select Switch to European Union or Switch to North America to choose your account's region.
